s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent urinary retention and sepsis with diffuse bladder wall thickening
salient_findings: Diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Near-complete loss of the detrusor muscle
Diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation with comma-shaped nuclei
Dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia
key_facts: 50-year-old man with known neurofibromatosis type 1
Multiple cutaneous neurofibromas
No history of smoking
Admitted for recurrent urinary retention and sepsis
Transurethral resection of the prostate revealed fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia
Urinary function did not improve after transurethral resection
CT scan showed diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall
Cystoprostatectomy was performed due to compromised bladder function
Bladder wall was diffusely thickened, firm, and gray-white on gross examination
Histologic evaluation revealed diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation
Tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56 on immunohistochemical studies
Tumor cells were negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, MDM2, p63, ALK, CD117, DOG1, myogenin, desmin, and smooth muscle actin

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor is in close contact with peripheral nerves

shortlist.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and multiple cutaneous neurofibromas

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor cells are positive for S100, which is a marker for schwannomas

shortlist.label: Neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has neurofibromatosis type 1 and the tumor has features of a neurofibroma

shortlist.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor has features of a spindle cell proliferation with a collagenous matrix

raw.rationale: The patient's history of neurofibromatosis type 1, presence of multiple cutaneous neurofibromas, and the tumor's characteristics such as diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation, prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern, along with the immunohistochemical profile, are consistent with a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

rejected.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
rejected.why: While the patient has neurofibromatosis type 1, the tumor's aggressive features and immunohistochemical profile are not typical of plexiform neurofibroma.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Schwannomas are typically benign and do not exhibit the cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and infiltrative growth pattern seen in this case.

rejected.label: Neurofibroma
rejected.why: Neurofibromas are benign and do not display the aggressive features and malignant characteristics observed in this tumor.

rejected.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
rejected.why: The tumor's immunohistochemical profile, including positivity for S100 and neurofilaments, is not consistent with a solitary fibrous tumor, which typically expresses CD34 and STAT6.
